slot.brief: Match commonly used antiseptic chemicals (dettol, bithionol, iodine tincture) with their use.

stem: Which preparation is an antiseptic solution of $\text{I}_2$ in an alcohol–water vehicle?

verdicts.working: Tincture of iodine is an antiseptic solution of I₂ in an alcohol–water vehicle.

working:
Tincture of iodine is a solution of $\text{I}_2$ in an alcohol–water mixture.

Independent check: Tincture of iodine is an antiseptic solution of I₂ in an alcohol–water vehicle.
